export.theServerSeesItWith: The server sees your IP address with each request. To prevent flooding, it counts requests from each address in memory for up to a day. It never saves the address, though a proxy in front of it might log it. The voice server also sees your IP address during calls. If you configure a SOCKS5 proxy on this device, the server sees the proxy's address instead.

Your servers and their media servers see the proxy's IP address instead of yours. The proxy can see which servers you connect to, when you connect and how much data you send. The contents stay encrypted.
